notes.title: Dodge Em Re-design
notes.notes:
Recently, Dodge Em that main game, has not been up to par and although the whole purpose is for these games to be silly and very unprofessionally made, Dodge em lacks the silly aspects turning more into a simulator. 

So, although as of now the main focus is Dark Space, Dodge em will be getting quality of life improvements and new gameplay elements. If all of these changes are in vain, the game will be removed, and the new main game would be Dark space, but this is unlikely to happen. Anyway, as always these are just some silly games to hopefully have some fun in. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New Game Mode! //Dark Space//
notes.notes:
A new semi horror style game-mode has been created! It will be called Dark Space and will feature many surprises. The focus on Mixed bag will be carried on later as Dark space with be one of the primary focuses. 

As always, these games are very silly and aren't professional made. ːsteamhappyː
